decisions.name: 曾淑勤
decisions.reason: The retained contact sheet shows a distant stage performer holding a guitar, with a microphone directly over the mouth and a very small face. No 600x720 clear eye/nose/mouth reveal is possible without substantial upscaling. Caption names 曾淑勤, but composition is unsuitable.
decisions.caption: ​臺灣女歌手曾淑勤。

decisions.name: 家家
decisions.reason: This is a restaurant-food photograph. Caption explicitly describes 家家美食 Ka Ka Cuisine Restaurant in Wong Tai Sin, not singer 家家. Zero human faces. Reject as an unrelated name collision, not an artist portrait.
decisions.caption: HK WTS zh:黃大仙 Wong Tai Sin zh:雙鳳街 Sheung Fung Street shop 家家美食 Ka Ka Cuisine Restaurant food September 2021

decisions.name: 以莉高露
decisions.reason: Source caption names 陳冠宇 and 以莉高露 together; retained contact sheet shows two prominent people in an indoor portrait. Neither is an approved isolated 600x720 face crop. Keep source for audit but reject as-is and seek a clear solo portrait of 以莉高露.
decisions.caption: ​陳冠宇與以莉高露

decisions.name: 黃玠
decisions.reason: Source explicitly depicts singer 黃玠瑋 (Zooey Wonder), NOT singer 黃玠. Distinct performers with overlapping Chinese name substring. Reject for wrong identity regardless of open-license metadata or crop quality.
decisions.caption: 2024 黃玠瑋 Zooey Wonder ＠The Wall Taipei

notes: These are source-only assets, not playable 600x720 crops; do not import as game approvals.
False positive names must be blocked before any future automatic photo approval: 家家美食 restaurant is not singer 家家; 黃玠瑋 is not 黃玠.
Retain source SHA and do not repeat the three older reviews.
